rules: Do not equate cbXRP issuance with a spot-market purchase; XRP may have been transferred from existing holdings into Coinbase custody.
Separate USDC supplied, USDC borrowed, cbXRP collateral units and XRP reserve balances.
Market-wide debt/collateral ratios are not borrower-weighted LTVs or individual liquidation probabilities.
Parameter/date matches support Coinbase-product attribution but do not prove every borrower entered through Coinbase.
Retain provider timestamps and incompatible field definitions; never average non-comparable observations.
